note: Small USFS campground (Gunnison RD, GMUG) in aspen at ~10,400 ft near Lake City, reached via SH 149, then FR 788 and FR 458 (dirt forest roads, a bit tight to maneuver but passable by ~30-ft rigs per campers). Lower sites overlook the small Deer Lakes. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 12 sites, FCFS, $18 (extra vehicle $9), vault toilets, Gunnison RD phone 970-641-0471. Added potable water (FS: available) and season May 19 - Sept 29 ('Site Closed' = end of season). Max 30 ft (camper-reported, note-derived) left: the agency states no length and does not single the campground out. Pin at the north end by the ponds, ~150-200 m from the site spurs (FS point is at the entrance, ~360 m south); OK. Lakeview plausible: spurs ~80-150 m from the ponds through aspen. Note trimmed.
flags: Rig length / road: the FS page states no maximum length and no road or RV advice (directions only: 'Turn left on FDR 458 and drive 2 miles'); the 'a bit tight ... ~30-ft rigs' wording is campers', kept in the note as such. No agency 4WD or high-clearance wording. No review from the last 3 years with a reviewer's own 23 ft+ rig was looked up in this pass.
Website: two links stored (recreation.gov listing + FS page); the FS page is the campground's own.
